title: Senior Cloud Consultant Agreement — Tier 1
full_text:
SENIOR CLOUD CONSULTANT AGREEMENT — TIER 1

Date: 10th February 2025
Company: Enterprise Horizon 9 Pvt. Ltd.
Role: Senior Cloud Consultant

1. Compensation and Benefits
The Company shall pay the Employee a total compensation of INR 26,00,000 per annum, payable in monthly instalments subject to statutory tax deductions.

2. Probationary Period
The Employee shall remain on probation for three (3) months from the date of joining. Performance will be reviewed prior to confirmation.

3. Notice Period and Separation
Following confirmation, either party may terminate employment by providing 45 days written notice or basic salary in lieu thereof.

5. Restrictive Covenant and Non-Compete
For 12 months following termination, the Employee agrees not to solicit clients or be employed by competing firms in India.

6. Confidentiality and Intellectual Property
All discoveries, software source codes, designs, and inventions created shall remain the exclusive proprietary property of the Company.

7. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
This contract shall be construed in accordance with the laws of India. Courts at Pune, Maharashtra have exclusive jurisdiction.

Sincerely,
Authorised Signatory
Enterprise Horizon 9 Pvt. Ltd.
